description: This is a PHP unit test class for the User model within the Goteo project. It contains test methods to verify user creation, deletion, and related database interactions.

classes.name: UserTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the Goteo Model User functionalities.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests if the User class can be instantiated properly.

methods.name: testCount
methods.description: Verifies the counts of users with different filters.

methods.name: testCreateUser
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new User, including its Avatar.

methods.name: testSuggestUserId
methods.description: Verifies the suggestion mechanism for user IDs based on input string.

methods.name: testDeleteUser
methods.description: Tests deleting a user and ensuring it no longer exists.

methods.name: testCleanUserRelated
methods.description: Checks data integrity between user and related tables, removing orphaned records.
